name: 4-party MABK witness on 4-qubit GHZ
task_prompt: Prepare a 4-qubit GHZ state and use StatevectorEstimator to evaluate the eight correlators in the standard four-party MABK expression; define the exact sign convention in code, compute its quantum value, and verify it against a direct matrix calculation within numerical precision. Respond with a single runnable Python file and no prose outside the code. The program must be CPU-runnable, deterministic where practical, and fail loudly through assertions when a requested property is not met.
